reviews.title: Excellent performing 360mm AIO for a budget price
reviews.comment: So my PC came with a 240mm AIO installed that just didn't cut it with my 13700KF. It would rapidly hit 100C under load and thermally throttle unless I set a power limit 80-100w under spec. It was also super loud. I looked into some reviews for AIO's and noticed that most of the best performing 360mm AIO's were $200+. That's when I happened to stumble across the Montech Hyperflow 360mm. This thing gets fantastic reviews and is FAR more reasonably priced. Installation was super easy with clear instructions and I didn't have a problem at all. Temps on my cpu dropped 20C and I can now run at full PL1/Pl2 253w without thermally throttling AND it is absolutely silent. This cooler was EXACTLY what I wanted. Cheers Montech!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great cooler and a great price
reviews.comment:
I was building a new PC and wanted a great AIO that didn’t cost an arm and the leg as well as having high performance. I was between the Arctic 360 cooler and this one. I had gotten a Montech case and wanted to match fans so I got this one.
The price is great, the fans work perfectly to cool stuff down AND the RGB is nice. Montech does a top notch job. The one thing I suppose could be a knock is installing it is a pain compared to the others, but it’s okay it’s doable.
TLDR buy this or the arctic you can’t go wrong with either.
reviews.author: Marcus

reviews.title: Good solid product & Easy Install
reviews.comment: I did a LOT of research on AIO products.  I looked at all the alternatives.  I looked at price vs build vs install vs warranty.  Really there's a LOT to look at.  I chose the Montech and as of today (3 days after install) I'm very happy with it.  It was an easy install.  It looks great.  And warranty is top of the market.  The fans are super quiet and the CPU is super chill.  I was able to remove 5 fans in my case for these 3 - 3 on roof of rig, 1 on the back, and 1 on CPU.  Now I just have 3 in front and I really can't hear it.  I've played Cyber Punk 77 at ultra resolution - everything maxed out - I can hear fans, but I'm thinking it may be from my GPU card.  Super HAPPY with this purchase!
reviews.author: Dan Nelson

reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C17vlqxmVZL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61P24uyRiAL._SY256.jpg Does exactly what it was bought for. I like the main brands, but I don't want to pay solely for a name and an at best, decent cooler with a mediocre warranty. So there were 3 contenders two had a 6 yr warranty (Montech is one of them) and the other had a seven year. Obviously I went with Montech. I'm glad I did because buying this cooler saved me from having to connect the fans to the radiator. All I had to do was build the socket bridge, so installation was a breeze! The colors, and looks of the cooler is great, as well as the performance. Opening night I did a test run after this build (my first one) everything fired up a-okay and we ran some tests to check performance and the cooler did a good job while the video card was under a heavy load.
reviews.author: SM

reviews.title: Very easy to mount on CPU and connect to ARGB V2
reviews.comment: Mounts perfectly on Montech HS02 Pro case and connects to ARGB V2 Hub that synchronized with rest of the fans. Mounting on CPU was very easy as bracket can be switched easily. It included an extra heat sink compound in case you need more (should not over apply). There are 8 fans + power supply fan running but they are very quiet.
